Function used to read through many subject files and concatenate into a dataframe
commented out output path option currently, may make an if statement if separate reusable .tsv files are needed later
```{r}
wrangle_data = function (path,pattern #, output_path
                         ) {
  files_list = list.files(path = path, pattern=pattern, recursive = TRUE, full.names=TRUE)

  results_file = map_dfr(files_list, function(x)
  {read_delim (x, delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE, na=c("NA", "", "n/a")) %>% 
    mutate(subject = str_extract(x, pattern = "sub-[^/\\\\_]+")) %>% 
    mutate(task = str_extract(x, pattern = "nback|rest")) %>%
    mutate (session = str_extract(x, pattern = "ses-0\\d")) %>%
    mutate (run = str_extract(x, pattern = "run-0\\d")) %>%
    select(subject, task, session, run, everything()) 
  })
  #write_tsv(results_file, output_path)
}
```

gscorr
-------------
function for global corr calculation:
```{r}
calculate_GC = function(dataframe, string){
  #timeseries datasets are in wide format, need to change format to long
  long_ts = dataframe %>% pivot_longer(cols = -c(subject,task,session,run), names_to = "Node", values_to="Value")
  
  if(string == "individual"){
    group = long_ts %>% group_by(subject, task, session, run, Node)
  } else if (string =="group"){
    group = long_ts%>% group_by(Node) 
  } else{
    print("Please specify group or individual analysis")
  }

  calculate =  group %>% 
    summarise(
     mean_GC = mean(Value), 
      Pos_GC = mean(subset(Value, Value>0)),
      Abs_GC = mean(abs(Value))
      )
}
```

Matrix to check variability between subjects
-------------------------------------------------
```{r}
matrixQC = function (dataframe, run_num, title_string){
  dataframe = filter(dataframe, run==run_num)
  #change Pos_GC to other metrics to get other matrices: such as mean_GC, Abs_GC
  wide = subset(dataframe, select=c(subject, Node, Pos_GC)) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = subject, values_from = Pos_GC) 
  wide = wide[, !(names(wide) %in% "Node")]
  matrix_calculate = cor(wide, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  
  ggcorrplot(matrix_calculate, hc.order = TRUE, type = "lower") +
  theme (axis.text.x = element_text(angle= 90, vjust=1, hjust = 1, size=8),
         axis.text.y = element_text(size=8)) +
  labs(title= title_string)
}
```
```{r}
matrixQC(GC_Glasser_individual, "run-01", "Glasser run-01")
matrixQC(GC_HCP_individual, "run-01", "HCP run-01")
#matrixQC(GC_4S156Parcels_individual, "run-01", "4S156 run-01")
```
```{r}
#timepoint comparison for QC
ten_sub = sample(unique(ts_Glasser_concatenate$subject), 10)

ts_Glasser_QC = ts_Glasser_concatenate %>% 
  filter(subject %in% ten_sub) %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  mutate(timepoint = row_number()) %>%
  select(subject, task, session, run, timepoint, everything()) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols=-c(subject,task,session,run,timepoint),
    names_to="Node", values_to="Signal"
  ) %>%
  na.omit(ts_Glasser_QC$Signal)

ggplot(ts_Glasser_QC, aes(x= timepoint, y= Signal, group = Node)) +
       geom_point() + geom_line() +
       facet_wrap(~ subject, scales="free_y")
```

```{r}
#grab all noddi result data, maybe filter also for low coverage?
noddi_Glasser_results = wrangle_data(path_noddi, "Glasser_model-noddi_results.tsv") %>% subset(select = -c(task,run))%>%
   rename(Node = name)%>%
   mutate(Node = str_replace(Node, "L_", "Left_") %>% 
           str_replace("R_", "Right_") %>%
           str_replace("_ROI", "")
        ) %>%
  filter(coverage>0.5)

noddi_Scahefer7N100_results = wrangle_data(path_noddi, "Schaefer7N100_model-noddi_results.tsv") %>% subset(select = -c(task,run)) %>%
  filter(coverage>0.5)

noddi_HCP_results = wrangle_data(path_noddi, "aparcaseg_model-noddi_results.tsv") %>% subset(select = -c(task,run)) %>%
  rename(Node = name) %>%
  mutate(Node=str_replace(Node, "-AREA", "") %>%
         str_replace("^RIGHT-(.*)$", "\\1_RIGHT") %>%
         str_replace("^LEFT-(.*)$", "\\1_LEFT") %>%
         str_replace("-STEM", "_STEM") %>%
         str_replace("VENTRALDC", "DIENCEPHALON_VENTRAL") %>%
         str_replace("-PROPER", "")
  ) %>%
  filter(coverage>0.5)
```

concatenating all metrics into one dataframe for easier filtering 
 - coverage for threshold >0.5
 - motion thresholded for <0.5
 - filtered out sub-CMH00000125 due to misaligned NODDI maps
```{r}

df_HCP= merge(df_HCP, age_df, by= c("subject")) %>%
```

```{r}
brainmap_Glasser = df_Glasser %>% group_by(Node) %>%
  summarise(
    ALFF= mean(ALFF, na.rm=TRUE),
    ReHo = mean(ReHo, na.rm=TRUE),
    mean_GC= mean(mean_GC, na.rm=TRUE),
    Pos_GC= mean(Pos_GC, na.rm=TRUE),
    Abs_GC= mean(Abs_GC, na.rm=TRUE),
    icvf_mean = mean(icvf_mean, na.rm=TRUE),
    od_mean= mean(od_mean, na.rm=TRUE)
 ) %>%
  rename(label=Node) %>%
  mutate(label = str_replace(label, "Left", "lh_L") %>% 
           str_replace("Right", "rh_R"))
  
brainmap_HCP = df_HCP %>% group_by(Node) %>%
  summarise(
    ALFF= mean(ALFF, na.rm=TRUE),
    ReHo = mean(ReHo, na.rm=TRUE),
    mean_GC= mean(mean_GC, na.rm=TRUE),
    Pos_GC= mean(Pos_GC, na.rm=TRUE),
    Abs_GC= mean(Abs_GC, na.rm=TRUE),
    icvf_mean = mean(icvf_mean, na.rm=TRUE),
    od_mean= mean(od_mean, na.rm=TRUE)
 ) %>% rename(label=Node)
brainmap_HCP$label = brainmap_HCP$label %>% tolower() %>%
  str_replace("^[a-z]", ~str_to_upper(.x)) %>%
  str_replace_all("_[a-z]", ~str_to_upper(.x)) %>%
  str_replace("(.*)_Right", "Right-\\1") %>%
  str_replace("(.*)_Left","Left-\\1") %>%
  str_replace("_Stem", "-Stem") %>%
  str_replace("Diencephalon_Ventral", "VentralDC") %>%
  str_replace("Thalamus", "Thalamus-Proper")
```

partial correlation - regressing out age for rsfMRI-NODDI
-------------------------------------------
```{r}
#run pcor test without any NA values
safe_pcor <- function(x, y, z) {
  if (length(x) >= 3 && length(y) >= 3 && length(z) >= 3) {
    tryCatch({
      pcor.test(x, y, z, method = "spearman")$estimate
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
}

#makes dataframe with age regressed out variables for rsfMRI-NODDI
#temp variable gets rid of any NA values, otherwise pcor cannot be run
glasser_partial_cor <- df_Glasser %>%
  group_by(Node) %>%
  summarise(
    alff_icvf_cor = {
      temp <- na.omit(data.frame(ALFF, icvf_mean, age_at_mri))
      safe_pcor(temp$ALFF, temp$icvf_mean, temp$age_at_mri)
    },
    alff_od_cor = {
      temp <- na.omit(data.frame(ALFF, od_mean, age_at_mri))
      safe_pcor(temp$ALFF, temp$od_mean, temp$age_at_mri)
    },
    reho_icvf_cor = {
      temp <- na.omit(data.frame(ReHo, icvf_mean, age_at_mri))
      safe_pcor(temp$ReHo, temp$icvf_mean, temp$age_at_mri)
    },
    reho_od_cor = {
      temp <- na.omit(data.frame(ReHo, od_mean, age_at_mri))
      safe_pcor(temp$ReHo, temp$od_mean, temp$age_at_mri)
    },
    GC_icvf_cor = {
      temp <- na.omit(data.frame(mean_GC, icvf_mean, age_at_mri))
      safe_pcor(temp$mean_GC, temp$icvf_mean, temp$age_at_mri)
    },
    GC_od_cor = {
      temp <- na.omit(data.frame(mean_GC, od_mean, age_at_mri))
      safe_pcor(temp$mean_GC, temp$od_mean, temp$age_at_mri)
    },
     Abs_GC_icvf_cor = {
      temp <- na.omit(data.frame(Abs_GC, icvf_mean, age_at_mri))
      safe_pcor(temp$Abs_GC, temp$icvf_mean, temp$age_at_mri)
    },
    Abs_GC_od_cor = {
      temp <- na.omit(data.frame(Abs_GC, od_mean, age_at_mri))
      safe_pcor(temp$Abs_GC, temp$od_mean, temp$age_at_mri)
    },
     Pos_GC_icvf_cor = {
      temp <- na.omit(data.frame(Pos_GC, icvf_mean, age_at_mri))
      safe_pcor(temp$Pos_GC, temp$icvf_mean, temp$age_at_mri)
    },
    Pos_GC_od_cor = {
      temp <- na.omit(data.frame(Pos_GC, od_mean, age_at_mri))
      safe_pcor(temp$Pos_GC, temp$od_mean, temp$age_at_mri)
    }
  ) 

#fix label names for brainmapping
glasser_partial_cor = glasser_partial_cor %>% rename(label=Node) %>%
  mutate(label = str_replace(label, "Left", "lh_L") %>% 
  str_replace("Right", "rh_R"))
```

```{r}
#fix label names to match ggseg aseg for brainmapping
HCP_partial_cor$label = HCP_partial_cor$label %>% tolower() %>%
  str_replace("^[a-z]", ~str_to_upper(.x)) %>%
  str_replace_all("_[a-z]", ~str_to_upper(.x)) %>%
  str_replace("(.*)_Right", "Right-\\1") %>%
  str_replace("(.*)_Left","Left-\\1") %>%
  str_replace("_Stem", "-Stem") %>%
  str_replace("Diencephalon_Ventral", "VentralDC") %>%
  str_replace("Thalamus", "Thalamus-Proper")
```
